name: ChartLegend
summary: Which colour is which series, as a plain list under the chart.

a11y.apg: none: a legend is a list of names and colours, not a widget. It is a real <ul> so the reader hears how many series there are, and each name is text — the colour is never the only thing that identifies a series.

props.name: payload
props.default: the series, in the engine's order
props.description: The entries to list. Worth passing: as of recharts 3.10.1 the engine sorts its own payload alphabetically by dataKey, so the legend does not follow the order the series were declared in. This prop is the way to fix that from the outside.

props.name: verticalAlign
props.description: Which side of the drawing the list sits on.

props.name: …Legend
props.description: Everything else goes to the engine's Legend. `content` is the exception: it is what this component IS.
